# cleaning dataset

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

x <- c(1)
movies_data <- read.csv("movie_data.csv")
movies_clean <- movies_data
movies_clean %>% map(~sum(is.na(.)))

movies_data <- read.csv("movie_data.csv")
head(movies_data)

movies_data <- drop_na(movies_data)
movies_clean <- movies_data
movies_clean %>% map(~sum(is.na(.)))

movies_clean$Run.Time <- movies_data$Run.Time %>% str_extract_all("\\d+") %>% map(~as.numeric(.)) %>%
  map(~.[1] * 60 + .[2]) %>% unlist()
```

```{r runtime cleanup}
movies_clean$Run.Time <-
  movies_clean$Run.Time %>%
  str_extract_all("\\d+") %>%
  map(as.numeric) %>%
  map(~ .[1] * 60 + dplyr::coalesce(.[2], 0)) %>%
  unlist()
```

```{r imdb review cleanup}
km <- function(string){
  if(!is.na(as.numeric(string))){
    num <- as.numeric(string)
  }
  if(str_detect(string, "K")){
    num <- as.numeric(str_sub(string, 1, -2)) * 1000
  }
  if(str_detect(string, "M")){
    num <- as.numeric(str_sub(string, 1, -2)) * 1000000
  }
  num
}

movies_clean$Count.of.IMDb.Ratings <-
  movies_clean$Count.of.IMDb.Ratings %>%
  map_dbl(km)
```

```{r genre cleanup}
movies_wide_genres <- movies_data %>% select(Title, Genre) %>% 
  separate_rows(Genre, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(present = TRUE) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Genre,
    values_from = present,
    values_fill = FALSE,
    values_fn = any
  )

movies_clean <- movies_clean %>% inner_join(movies_wide_genres, by = "Title")
```

```{r release date}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

movies_clean <- movies_data |> 
                  separate(
                    Release.Date,
                    into = c("Release.Date", "Country"),
                    sep = "\\(", 
                    fill= "right"
                    ) |>
                        mutate(date = str_trim(Release.Date),
                                Country = str_trim(sub("\\)$", "", Country)),
                                Release.Month= str_extract(date, "^[A-Za-z]+")
                              ) |>
                                relocate(Release.Month, .before = Release.Date)
```

```{r budget}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(stringr)

#assume 3% average annual inflation
base_year <- 2026
annual_inflation <- 0.03 

#identify what currencies are there
movies_data %>%
  mutate(budget_currency = str_trim(str_extract(Budget, "^[^0-9]+"))) %>%
  count(budget_currency, sort = TRUE)

#exchange rates as of 20 Feb 2026
exchange_rates <- tibble(
  budget_currency = c("$", "£", "EUR", "CA$", "A$", "¥", "RUR", "₹", "CN¥", "R$", "THB"),
  rate_to_usd = c(
    1.00,   # USD
    1.35,   # GBP
    1.18,   # EUR
    0.73,   # CAD
    0.71,   # AUD
    0.0065, # JPY
    0.013,  # RUR (old russian ruble)
    0.011,  # INR
    0.14,   # CNY
    0.19,   # BRL
    0.032   # THB
  )
)

#convert
movies_clean <- movies_data %>%
  mutate(
    budget_usd_2026 = {
      currency <- str_trim(str_extract(Budget, "^[^0-9]+"))
      currency[is.na(currency)] <- "$"

      # standardize: old currencies to euro
      currency[currency == "€"] <- "EUR"
      currency[currency %in% c("DEM", "FRF")] <- "EUR"

      value <- parse_number(Budget) 

      rate <- exchange_rates$rate_to_usd[match(currency, exchange_rates$budget_currency)]
      rate[is.na(rate)] <- 1  # if no currency, treat as USD

      years <- base_year - as.integer(Year) 

      (value * rate) * (1 + annual_inflation)^years #inflate to 2026 USD (future value formula)
    }
  )
```

```{r domestic gross}
class(movies_clean[["Domestic.Gross"]][1]) #so we know its a character

movies_clean[["Domestic.Gross"]] <- as.numeric(gsub("[\\$,]", "", movies_clean[["Domestic.Gross"]]))

class(movies_clean[["Domestic.Gross"]][1])
```

```{r domestic weekend gross}
movies_clean[["Domestic.Weekend.Gross"]] <- as.numeric(gsub("[\\$,]", "", movies_clean[["Domestic.Weekend.Gross"]]))
```

```{r worldwide gross}
movies_clean[["Worldwide.Gross"]] <- as.numeric(gsub("[\\$,]", "", movies_clean[["Worldwide.Gross"]]))
```

```{r gross account for inflation}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

movies_clean <- movies_clean %>%
  mutate(
    domestic_gross_2026 =
      Domestic.Gross *
      (1 + annual_inflation)^(base_year - as.integer(Year)),

    domestic_weekend_gross_2026 =
      Domestic.Weekend.Gross *
      (1 + annual_inflation)^(base_year - as.integer(Year)),

    worldwide_gross_2026 =
      Worldwide.Gross *
      (1 + annual_inflation)^(base_year - as.integer(Year))
  )
```
